notes.title: Elewar: Roguelike!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's me again with the 3rd large scale update for Elewar!

In the previous large updates we've had new spell fusions, we've had new classes, relics and prophecies...

With the amount of content the game has, new stuff isn't even needed anymore, so what am I up to now?

After you beat the hell realm for the first time, you will unlock a new gamemode - Roguelike mode.
This one is very different from the basegame and will hook you with its new set of challenges and it's variety. A new equipment slot is now also available for you through the mode! While available early on the gold and mythril rewards will scale up to the endgame, so you can alternate between the basegame and this new mode whenever you want!

This is the last large scale update for now (At least for the next 3 months), I will provide further fixes and maybe some minor content patches in the next week.


Thank you for playing the game and taking part in my very first game development project! 
All of your reviews, feedback's and kind words mean a world to me.

And all of you who went an extra mile by recommending this game to others or supported me by buying the cosmetic DLC/via Patreon and KoFi - You guys are super awesome! Your help gives me the confidence to take on an even better project in the future!



 added an alternative game play mode, which will drastically change all the game play rules, providing new challenges, unlocks, a new item type and an additional way to farm in mid and late game.
 Roguelike game mode: Monsters no longer give exp, the realm no longer has a timer -> instead you choose from different stages with diverse objectives to accomplish (Kill x enemies, survive x sec, collect all objects etc.) and those will also feature a corresponding reward. You progress through the stages with increasingly dangerous encounters while trying to find the best way to scale with the new systems.
 There are over 50 handcrafted stages for you to conquer, providing a refreshing new way to experience the game. 
 added 16 new unlocks, all enhancing the new alternative game play mode
 added a new hidden class: Joker
 When playing in the new mode, your class will be fixed to be the Joker. This cannot be picked in normal realms, but can be upgraded through new mode unlocks
 added a new item type: Glove. You can get a new glove when playing in the new mode, provided you have the corresponding unlock. Glove items always drop as legendary and are expensive to craft. They provide positive and negative modifiers (Like boots do), but they can be crafted deterministically (Can craft perfect mods via gold). Mods will have a very high variance, so re-crafting may improve it further.
 added a visual queue for when players get invulnerability frames (via blessing), same for enemies
 fixed contamination dps preview bug
 several other small fixes

notes.title: Elewar: Fused Survivors 1.2 - new Classes, Unlocks, Relics, Blessings ...
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I got another big update to share, this time focussing on early game and more content!
Improving the starting experience, as well as expanding on the mid/late game possibilities!
There are now [strike]12[/strike] -> 18 classes in the game together with the dual class system there is now just so much stuff to explore!

Before we go into the patchnotes, if you would like to support the Developer, you can now buy the DLC:
Elewar: Fused Survivors - DONATION - Elemental Aura

This one gives the player a visual elemental aura, which changes its appearance depending on what element does the highest damage in your current run! (Does not affect gameplay)

Patchnotes:

  added 25 new unlocks
  added a new starter class: Hero
  added a new starter class: Mirage
  added a new advanced class: Mastermind
  added a new advanced class: Curator
  added a new advanced class: Voidwalker
  Apprentice is now separated from Electrokin, with its own evolutions and a transformation
  Electrokin is now its own class, unlocking later on
  changed some unlock conditions for classes and their order in class selection
  base movement speed of the player +25, upgrade ms reduced a little, which still makes it 10-15% buff
  added 2 new relics
  added 2 new blessings
  added a new prophecy: That’s bad?
  added a new prophecy: All in
  added 3 very expensive upgrades to increase the number of burden rerolls
  buffed corrupted burdens reroll blessing (-30% corruption -> -15%)
  added a new corrupted benefit: "your resistance is multiplied by: 2"
  fixed an epic ember spin bug with returning projectiles (If this skill still causes a crash please report the bug :) )
  added an endgame unlock to have a modfilter for armor rolling
  added a back button to the class and spell selection

Because there are many ways to become pretty much immortal, neither the player nor the boss would damage each other resulting very lengthy fights.
Boss enrage changes:

 Previously bosses doubled their damage every minute of their lifetime.
 Now bosses will 2x their damage after 1 minute, 4x their dmg again after 2 minutes, and 10x their damage for every minute after that. (Only applies to midgame/endgame realms)

notes.title: Elewar: Fused Survivors 1.1- Large content patch, a way to support the developer
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Thank you all so much for playing the game! The response I’ve received from you has been phenomenal, and I’m excited to surprise you once again with this large new content release!

Elewar and all of its content will remain free forever, but if you’d like to support me further, I’ve set up a Patreon account. 

This way, you can help support what I’m doing financially. You can find the link to the Patreon page in Elewar's Discord channel. 

Now lets continue with the changes:

 So far there were 10 epic spell fusions in the game and players liked them so much that I've decided to increase that number to .... 20! 
  Now every single offensive spell has an epic fusion version with escalating visual and mechanical upgrades!
 The first 15 fusions will be available as soon as you unlock them, but the hints on what conditions have to be met, will unlock for you after every successful fusion
  The last 5 fusions are a little bit more special, to not spoil too much - you will have to unlock the Darkness realm first, before having a chance to get those

 Added 2 new unlockable prophecies
	(Chasing Nightmare, Hindering Impact)
 Added 5 new base prophecies
   (Chasing Hurricane, Attack from above, Bombardment from above, Blocking Impact, Investment Benefits)

 Tsunami prophecy reward now instead makes magnets additionally pull in utility-lvl-ups
 Firestorm prophecy is not limited to 2

 Added 3 new upgrades (+5% movement speed x3), to compensate the removal of tsunami prophecy's movement speed reward

 You can see what perks can only be taken a limited number of times (Max x)
 Buffed Relic of Patience, lightning damage per run started from 3 -> 15

 Updated the tooltip for procs to mention the procs are always of rare rarity
 You may look up on your utility spells in the pause menu
 Corruption tab now additionally feautures the current corruption lvl and can be focussed to see the explanation of what it does
 Relic selection will not overlap with the lvl-up menus anymore
 Minimap on the setting small was desynced, showing objects on wrong places until resizing once

More Controller Fixes:

 Controller focus gets lost when the button that has focus is hidden/transformed. Fixed for Character Class menu, Corruption Benefits Menu, Crafting Menu for equipment
 Improved Inventory menu handling for controllers, the focus does not get lost in the submenu of an item. Also you can now focus your equipped items.
 You can also look through your equipped items in the pausemenu of a run
 All text fields like "player name", "seed number" or "twitch channel name" now require a click to enable the virtual keyboard
 Highscores focus is now more intuitive

notes.title: Patchnotes for Elewar: Fused Survivors. Full release on 21th August 6pm CET.
notes.content:
Its finally time! Elewar: Fused Survivors full release on 21th August is closing in, so check out the BIG changelog of new stuff! (21th August 6pm CET)

If you would rather avoid spoilers on new unlocks, you can skip those patchnotes and discover everything yourself!


New major content

Dual class system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372319/275a0d65cace84f40fb0f6c3fb96d863d9db294a.gif

 Added the unlocked ability to select a secondary class - you will gain relics and class powers of your primary and secondary class at the same time! Find the best combinations, while evolving both classes at once!


Pet inventory slot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372319/159cfd5840bc0f1ff67852b4bd80496b8bdce8fe.gif

 Added a new inventory category: pets.
 Item system now supports modifiers which are fixed to the item and are not rerollable or changeable, in addition to the current rerollable modifiers.
 Pets will be unlocked through finishing different trial levels on the realms.
 Pets can have fixed unique modifiers and a unique type of modifiers impacting events and the strength of the pet.


Corruption enters the realms

 Added a new event type: Corrupted Level-ups. Take on burdens to gather corruption and spend it to gain the new unique corruption-perks. Or let the gathered corruption spread into your realm ...
 Added benefitial corruption effects based on your corruption level (Corruption freed into the realm rises the corruption level of the area).
 Added corrupted enemies as the first level of the new corruption mechanic and unique advantages for the later levels.
 Darkness realm now specializes in the corruption mechanic, but through new unlocks you will be able to spread even more corruption in the other realms.


Endgame
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372319/824f6ba4f737321caa91bc5187529e2b7d68f1e2.gif

 Added the legendary sixth trial to all realms (unlocked by beating darkness 5).
 All classes may now evolve to level 6 (Through Heaven legendary trial level 6).
 Added 7 new unlocks/crafting methods for boots and pets for Darkness trial level 6.
 Added a new realm to the game: Infinity.


Armor inventory slot

 Added armors to the game, those can only be obtained by using the corruption system.
 An armor can have 1-8 modifiers, depending on your unlocks. You can only "reroll all mods" or "reroll the rarities of all mods" on the armor, there is no other way to craft on an armor.
 Crafting methods on an armor are very expensive, and are unlocked in mid/end game.
 Every time you use a crafting method on an armor, you will increase the chances for higher rarity modifiers for all future crafting methods on armor by 1%.
 E.g. After rerolling the mods of an armor 100 times, you will have double the chances for magic/rare/legendary modifiers. 
 This increase is global, so even if you find another armor you will profit from those bonuses. 
 This opens up a gold sink which steadily increases players potential to craft a godlike armor, while still making the armor slot be awesome early on, albeit with a lower number of high rarity mods on it.


Status rework

 Every status ailment infliction now also applies a damaging dot onto the enemy which scales based on the hit which inflicted the status, with the exception of it's critical strikes, as those will not increase the dot.
 Those dots can stack up on the enemy, which will provide even more opportunities to scale your build. It is now also possible to stack up status chance over 100%. Example: with 250% chance to cause a status you will apply 2 DOT effects per hit and have a 50% chance to apply a third dot effect on the same hit. (Shoutout to Last Epoch!)
 Added 3 new perks: status damage % , status dot stacks aplied +x flat (Rare, Legendary), status dot stacks applied multiplier *x (Legendary only).


RNG Seed system

 Added a RNG seed system into the game.
 Once unlocked you can type in your seed number and the following RNG-Events will be influenced by it: Perk Rarities, Perk types, Relic order, Epic relic encounter, all lvl-up-perk conditions, all prophecies available for chosing, golden prophecy whirl chances, square event symbols, corrupted burdens, corrupted benefits and random spawns which happen throughout the run.

(--> Yep, you can fish for a seed with a Relic right from the start of the run)


Other new content

 Continued the story line.
 Added LOTS of new unlocks and upgrades.
 Added 4 new classes (Phantom, Trainer, Muscle, Chaos).
 Added a new unlockable mechanic: super crit.
 New realm events! Those trigger automatically at specific times .
 Added lots of new relics.
 Added new level-up perks.
 Added 11 new epic versions of relics.
 Added new prophecies.
 Added new blessings.
 Added 1 more enemy type.
 Added twitch integration to the game: viewers may vote on which prophecies are chosen. For this check out the new submenu of the options.
 Boots can now have a secret slot modifier, as with the normal mods on boots, the secret slot can have most of the outcomes from weapons and helmets slots.
 Added the 3rd challenge (Heaven realm).
 Added the 4th challenge (Darkness realm).


Graphics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44372319/18d6e30561eae138c65429b526458f409962cc41.gif

 Added visual trail effects to lots of spells.
 Improved visuals and feel of most of the menues, tooltips.
 Improved visuals of the square event charging.
 Updated the main menu visuals, also added a new option to modify its appearance based on current progress.
 Updated steam assets.
 Cleaned up some unlock icons.
 Added and updated distinct class visuals for all classes.
 Class visuals may now overlap when taking a secondary class.
 Updated the tutorial, updated grasland visuals.


Quality of Life & Performance


 Improved the performance, fixed teleporting when on very low fps.
 Added tooltips for all lvl-up perks, which explain what the perk does in detail.
 Added a some help for new players: in the realm selection menu you will now see a quest, which guides you towards powerful upgrades.
 Reworked the highscore system, making it easy to add new ones. Prepare to be able to compete globally or against your steam friend list! 
 Tooltips for status perks and pausemenu were updated.
 Reworked the internals of the unlock system menu, added descriptive header lines and rearranged all unlocks based on a thematic order.
 Similarly to the new unlocks screen added header text boxes for easier upgrades menu visibility.
 Added a "new" label to new items, this disappears on hovering over them.
 You may now look at all possible outcomes for a secret slot in the crafting menu.
 Added new stats to the pausemenu and end run statistics menu: Total spell damage, Total status damage.
 Added a new stat to the tooltip for skills and pausemenu: Status potential --- this one describes how much DPS your statusses deal when compared to the spells DPS -> Status potential of 200% means your statusses deal double DPS of your normal spell hits.
 Added a checkbox to save your seed between runs.
 Added a cheat sheet to the potential rift menu, which reminds you of unlocked hidden fusions (Epic Rarity spell conditions).
 Added a cheat sheet for epic spells to the blessing and spell selection menu.
 Blessing counter is now flashing red if you have unlocked blessings but not chosen any yet.
 Updated some mod descriptions to be more consistent.
 Added a crafting method to remove the secret slot modifier.
 Improved multi class selection by adding 2 buttons (primary/secondary) and also updated the menu visuals.
 Pause menu now also shows all versions of procs and their correct stats (So if you have 40% winter curve lvl 1 and 40% winters curve on critcast, you can see the differences of lvl 40 to lvl1).
 Pause menu now shows your element immunities.
 Changed damage number formatting to letters (k,m,b,t,q) for easier reading in lategame.
 Added checkmarks to the unlock categories showing that all unlocks in a category are completed.
 Added a new pop up menues for large unlocks.
 Added a new pausemenu category: Corruption. You can see your selected corruption benefits in here.
 When doing the first challenge the hit box setting automatically turns on.
 When doing the 2nd and 4th challenge the setting for automatic usage of utility spells turns off.
 When doing the 4th challenge, camera automatically zooms out.
 Secondary class now also registers a new highscore.
 Hovering over an unlock for a new relic will now also show the relic's stats.


Options rework

 Reworked the options menu to include categories.
 Added 2 new minimap options: move minimap into the middle of the screen, and adjust minimap opacity.
 Added an option to turn of all trail effects on spells.
 Added an option to turn of elemental hit sounds.
 Added a new experimental setting: increase game speed by up to 2.0.
 Added a new setting: adjust transparency of player skills.
 Added a new setting: Camera Zoom.
 Added a new setting: show chances for rarities in lvl-up menu (default: turned off).
 Added a virtual keyboard for typing fields while using a controller.
 Added a new setting to disable game pausing when the game window is not focused.
 Added a FPS-Limit setting (30, 60, 144, unlimited).
 Added a new setting: Level-up Timer stops counting down at 2 seconds.


Miscellaneous

 Im really curious on how many people read patchnotes in detail. If you did catch this message, can you please make a comment that starts with "Ok".
 Added lots of new steam achievements.
 Updated the steam page (trailer, screenshots, texts).
 Added a credits page to the options menu.
 Adjusted self control description.
 Added lots of new sound effects.
 Added 2 new songs, which are now the starting songs for the heaven and darkness realms.
 Adjusted the armor text in the inventory.
 Changed up the Epic rarity color a little bit on spells and relics.
 Normalised some perk descriptions.
 Added a little formating/text changes to the epic spell fusion confirmation.
 Added a "Blessing" label to the blessings in the upgrade menu.
 Leaderboards now refresh your name even if you renamed after acquiring the spot.
 Class highscores now prioritise trial lvl 6 over realm.
 Speedrun blessing will not skip time if the timer is currently stopped.


Balance Changes

 Modified all current classes to also have a drawback to make using the dual class system have its up and downsides.
 You can now reduce the difficulties of the challenges after failing to do them.
 Rebalanced all utility perk values.
 Rebalanced all offensive spells.
 Rebalanced most of the relics.
 Damage multiplier while standing now works with the "always standing relic" and "always standing blessing".
 Reduced the duration of status effects to 5 seconds base.
 Negative crit rate limited to -100%.
 Buffed Hell starting gold bonus to 200% (from 150%).
 Buffed Heaven starting gold bonus to 500% (from 300%).
 Buffed Darkness starting gold bonus to 1000% (from 500%).
 The scaling gold bonus per trial level is unchanged for now.
 Buffed enemy scaling life numbers in the later realms.
 Changed reward of elite onslaught prochecy from "reduce enemy life to 70%" to "enemies multicast is reduced to minimum".
 Buffed higher rarity perk chances.
 Golden prophecy whirls now always feature 4 options to choose from.
 Doubled xp from elite enemies.
 Bosses now enrage after 60 seconds (previously 90).
 Bosses now double their damage after every enrage (previously 40% more damage).
 Reduced enemy multicasts by 1 in Heaven and Darkness realm.
 Rewritten the HP scaling code of monsters.
 Spell deletion does not work against spells created by events/prophecies anymore.
 Cant do negative dmg anymore.
 Being revived by pet will not bypass current Hp being fixed at 1.
 Tmp shield on kill relic now also works with status killed enemies.
 Reduced enemy laser duration to 0.2 sec (from 0.3), to make it more insync with the sound effect.
 Muscle now starts with 10% supercrit chance.
 Corrupted benefits cannot roll the same benefit in the same selection twice.
 Reduced the unlock for 3m crits to 1m crits.
 Dodge will no longer be rolled before autododges are used. So now autododges will not be protected by dodge chance %.
 Dot stacks for status perk now limited to 3 per run.
 Perk free lvl ups for the player is banished after 5 times.
 Prophecy Slower Paced is now limited to 3.
 Damage of prophecies now has 40% pen, lowered the base damage to compensate.
 Slightly reduced frequency of lasers during prophecy-events.
 Immunity to cold/lightning benefit disabled the other one (but if you see both in the same selection, you can still take double immunity).
 Disaster prophecy now spawns 2 potential rifts as the reward.
 Buffed all tmp shield on status mods.
 Rerolling burdens while reducing their cost now has a minimum of +0 corruption.
 Reworked the magnet scaling builds.


Crafting Changes

 You cannot roll the same mod again, when its already on the item -> more different items and strategies required, instead of just having 1 mod 4x.
 Buffed individual item mods (e.g. Legendary perks chance 90% -> 150%).
 Your old items are still usable even if they are illegal, you can play with them normaly, with 1 exception: highscores wont register. 
  So if you wanna claim one of the top spots in the new leaderboard categories - craft up some new sick stuff (You can also just recraft your old stuff to be legal).
 Added chance for rare perks mod for helmets.
 Added crafting method: add a guaranteed legendary mod to helmets.
 Added damage multiplier if hit did not inflict status as a craftable mod to helmets, armors, and boots.
 Changed weapon modifiers, buffed all damage values, enabled rolling percentage based modifiers on normal rarity.
 Improved crafting chances for lower rarity items.
 Crafting "chance for legendary perks" on items now has a variance.


Bug Fixes

 Added a minimum amount value to all skills which use particle systems and scale the number of those with AoE.
 Added an additional check for event-spawned enemies, if those did not spawn correctly, the event stops counting them into the objective after 10 seconds have passed.
 Fixed a bug with a hidden password, which could reset your trial progress.
 Fixed a crash when exiting out of the pause menu while hovering over a blessing.
 Added the posibility to ignore sounds if the same effect is repeated too fast. This will further optimize endgame scenarios where hundredths/thousandths of hits were made per second, each trying to play a hit-sound effect.
 Fixed tmp-shield UI elements going into the healthbar when reaching values of over 9999.
 Fixed a bug with chain shock, which still showed skill animation when used by a decoy when player effects were disabled.
 Fixed several cases where minimap could overlap with some menues if set to 2x size.
 Corrected the lvl-up perk rarities UI to work with negative chances for a specific rarity.
 Fixed a bug with crafting mods, which sometimes could spawn mod of the same modtype twice.
 Fixed a bug with dmg on status / non status, if this perk was taken while it has a condition.
 Fixed dps preview with dot stack perk.
 Fixed a bug with pets eating enemy spells not working.
 Fixed a bug where multiple procs with the same spell being proced and with the same condition did not work (Especially noticeable with procer + Corruption proc).
 Fixed a bug with the most prophecy whirls taken highscore category.
 Fixed a bug where chain shock could cause timescale changes on higher game speeds.
 Fixed a typo with the text for enemy spell autodeletion mod.
 Added a small delay to the games autopausing when losing focus on game window.
 Fixed 42 runs started unlock to track and complete properly.
 Corrupted vision now doesn't obstuct the prophecy whirls menus.
 Fixed a bug with german text being larger than the burdens button.
 Fixed a bug where UI didnt update after the player got an additional utility spell slot.
 Pausemenu will not be called when the game loses focus and the game is already paused via other menus.
 Fixed a bug where the relic tooltip was slighly offscreen after unlocking all the extra choices.
 Fixed a bug where the 20 shield from unlocks weren't properly converted to health when playing masochist.
 Fixed a bug where utility minimum level as a corrupted benefit did not work.
 Fixed text overlap in challenge 2.
 Superboss event from the chaos class now correctly disappears if you kill the boss before the timer runs out.
 Fixed player spawn time depending on fps.
 Phantom now only shows the no xp event on getting hit at most one time, instead of spamming the screen with it when hit multiple times.
 Fixed a bug where armors with 8 mods caused a game freeze if you rolled all of its modifiers as normal rarity.
 Fixed "reach corruption level 6 - x times" unlocks not tracking properly.
 Added a small delay to getting the relic selection menu to not overlap with a possible running lvl-up window.
 Adjusted blazing spot's transparency setting changes, as this spell overlaps lots of particles it behaves differently, but i've tried to reproduce the visual transparency based on the settings value.
 Fixed a crash appearing when selecting "+1 relic" utility lvl-up perk.
 When you load the modification of an item and the loaded version does not have a relic slot filled in yet, but the current item does have a relic -> the relic will be added to the loaded item version.
 Fixed pets moving weirdly.
 Fixed choose secondary class buttons not correctly disabled if the class is not unlocked.
 Epic fusion menu appearance is now delayed for 0.5sec, to avoid it proccing at the same time as a lvlup.
 When banishing the exact same perk twice, banish will not disappear (may still banish same perktype twice).
 Corruption based events now also trigger if the timer is not going forward.
 Fixed a bug where rerolling prophecies showed the wrong difficulty on the side.
 Fixed game freeze related to rerolling benefits lots of times.
 Fixed a possible crash when rerolling corrupted benefits.
 Fixed a bug where spells which got an element tag added onto them, didn't receive an extra elemental scaling after upgrading to epic if  the tag was the same as the epic spell extra element tag.
 Fixed a bug where crit multi/chance efficiency modifiers didn't work properly on the level-up menu spell slot (to the far right, conditioned for only one spell).
 Enemies are now immune to damage for 0.2 sec after spawning.
 Super crit is now capped at 100%.
 Cannot remove spells if you only have 1 spell.
 Fixed a bug where the saved seed was sometimes overwritten.
 Fixed a bug where Relic of Learning didnt remove any potential.
 Fixed a bug where Relic of Wholeness didn't scale with base status chance.
 Fixed a bug where one could let the runtimer continue event without defeating the 20minutes bosses in trial 6 realms.
 Fixed a bug where epic erratic bolts  which got deleted, gave you a flaring presence.
 Fixed a bug where the darkness challenge was complety black if started after doing a graslands run.
 Perks for damage on status hits now also display the correct number (e.g. 1.44 was visually rounded to 1.4).
 Icicles created by the epic Divine Tornado spell will now behave separately from the Icicle Ruination spell, thus not triggering each others shooting attacks.

notes.title: Elewar: Fused Survivors release date announcement
notes.content:
Elewar: Fused Survivors is set to officially leave Early Access and be fully released on August 21th! This journey has been a labor of love, and I couldn't have done it without your amazing support and feedback.

Hype time? You bet! The full game will feature a ridiculous amount of content, much more than I originally planned for the full release!


 A custom trial system for each of the 5 realms, challenging you to strategize and boost your builds to their limits. The farther you go, the more possibilities will unlock for you! Prepare to discover new things even after reaching the endgame.
 Over 300 unlocks with corresponding rewards.
 Over 140 buyable upgrades.
 A diverse crafting system for permanent equipment scaling into the endgame.
 12 classes and a dual class system, with the possibility to evolve classes to a higher power level.
 20 different attack spells, which change drastically after reaching the highest power level.
 Over 35 different event types you can encounter in your runs to define your own RISK vs REWARD ratio.


For all of the details between the current version and 1.0, you can also check out the discord channel .
For newcomers, I recommend starting out with the beta branch on Steam or waiting until the full release. It has lots of bug fixes, quality of life changes and new contents.

I can't thank you enough for your support and dedication throughout the Early Access phase. Your feedback has shaped Elewar into the game it is today, and I’m super excited for you to experience all the new content and improvements!

notes.title: Elewar: Fused Survivors - Whats next? ---> 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

in case you were wondering where i disappeared to, dont worry Im still actively working on the game and preparing the largest update ever. This is still some months away, but it will be packed!

From time to time i need some rest, where i mostly play other games, and after those small breaks im developing lots of new stuff into Elewar. I want the next update to be the final 1.0 update, that is the reason why you stopped seeing small patches every now and then (Im bundling all the changes together, as they will change the game drasticly)

I still have LOTS of stuff planned, but here is a little sneakpeak at what is already implemented in my dev-build:


 Dual class - select a secondary class to combine their effects!
 Pets! New item slot where you can equip pets with various effects
 Corruption enters the realms - and with it the corrupted version of lvl ups where you may take up negative modifiers to profit from super powerful and unique corruption perks
 all status ailments now also apply a dmg dot, you can focus on this dot to stack up thousands ofdot stacks onto the enemies
 Armor item type! This one will give you the ability to dump millions of gold into it and craft insanely strong armors
 highscores rework and over 30 categories!
 lots of new perks for rare/legendary lvl-up perks 
 super crit
 lots of new unlocks
 tooltips for lvl-up-perks
 rework of the options menu
 performance boosts!
 lots of bug fixes and QOL is already in



If you would like to stay up to date, join the games discord at https://discord.gg/pFNNXAawXN , where i post frequent teasers and patch notes for my internal build!

notes.title: Megapatch has arrived - New content awaits!
notes.content:
A little over a month ago Elewar: Fused Survivors was released on steam. I've got tons of feedback and received very kind words from you all, thank you sincerely!

Patchnotes:

New Content


 added a new unlock to get access to holy spells
 implemented a fusion system to upgrade specific spells to epic rarity
 added 5 epic spell variants
 implemented the 3rd realm: Heaven
 One of the specialties of Heaven, which you will love: On winning a run in Heaven realm your character class will upgrade to it's next "Evolution level". Every class will have their own unique modifiers as well as very desired generic upgrades added to them on clearing Heaven Realm
 Evolution levels for classes: clearing Heaven Realm on Trial 0 will advance your Class to Evolution level 1, to get to the 2nd evolution level, you will need to conquer Heaven on Trial1 etc.
 implemented 5 evolution level - modifiers for every class. The first two are unique to the class
 implemented the 4th Realm: Darkness
 introducing a new high end currency: Mythril
 new crafting option which uses mythril: "reroll all mods of an item, all resulting mods will be of legendary rarity"
 new crafting option which uses mythril: "Adds or rerolls the secret slot modifier"
 once unlocked there is a once in a run chance for an Epic rarity relic to spawn, those are much stronger than their original versions
 added 4 new categories of unlocks (But you gotta unlock those first ːsteammockingː)
 created over 90 new unlocks
 added 25 new upgrades
 added 6 new relics, with synergistic effects because its fun to find strong combos
 added a new mob type
 added a new basic prophecy: Clean Up.  Convert all hearts to utility level-ups
 added 2 new highscore categories



QOL (Quality of life changes):

 added a shield bar under the character lifebar, this one rescales depending on the amount of shield you have and gets much larger if you have lots of shield
 you can now sell items faster by holding the E-key and left clicking on the item (careful, there is no confirm prompt when doing this)  [ Playstation Controller Hold □  then X, Xbox Controller hold X then A ]
 added a tooltip to also explain the selling shortcut ingame
 you can now lock an item from being selled, those will be marked with an X in inventory
 future boots items now highlight their negative mods in red (currently owned ones will not highlight)
 you can now see what perks are banished from appearing again when you pick them
 you can now see the maximum number a prophecy can be taken until it is banished from the run
 added a new crafting option for weapons: add a legendary mod (Slightly more expensive than doing the load/add method, but so much faster)
 added some custom sorting to the spell selection at the start (-> loading will now be in the same order)
 added the option to lock an element and its current spells, those will not change when rerolling the starting spell selection
 added a "current quest" label to the crafting menu to tell the player what he has to do to unlock better crafting/drop options


Balancing:

 upgrades are now cheaper at the beginning, more expensive at the end
 buffed xp formula for lategame
 lowered the dodge cap to 80% (88% with the limitbreak relic)

 elites now gain 5% damage multiplier for every 20 seconds of their lifetime
 for every 90 seconds of their lifetime, bosses multiply their dmg stat by 40%

 Blessing with the delay for skills now rewards you by doubling your activation range of all skills
 relic of trickiness gives 3 lvl per magnet
 relic of greed now gives a magnet every 1000 kills instead of 800
 relic of nimis now adds +50% dmg
 relic of wholeness now increases dmg by 50% when not inflicting a status ailment
 relic of agility increases dodge by 50%, you are scorched if effect is activated
 relic of transcendence now gives 140 shield per heart
 relic of opposites: additionally gives "Your relics will treat you as if you were always standing."
 added a soft/hard cap for skill duration perks (stronger diminishing returns after 500% duration)
 dot damage capped at 20 dot damage ticks per second out of 1 single multicast (0.05 sec application time) (So with 10 dot fields you still do 200 dmg ticks per second at max). Probably 0 difference to before for 99.9% of builds.
 proc perks can now only be taken once (Per type of proc perk) and will not appear afterwards
 laser hell prophecy now rewards 2 lvls per magnet instead of 4
 slightly tweaked trial modifiers



Most of the spells gained some power or stayed the same.
Additionally I shifted some multicasts from spells to their rarities (So they are weaker on normal rarity and same or stronger on magic+ rarity)


 Icicle Ruination:
gains +1 multicast at magic rarity
100% more dmg instead of 50% more dmg on legendary

 Blazing Spot:
1 less multicast overall
now gains 2 multicast on magic
now gains 3 multicast on rare
now gains 4 multicast on legendary

 Fireball:
1 less multicast overall
now gains 2 multicast on magic
now gains 4 multicast on rare
increased cooldown by about 10%

 Flaring Presence:
gains 10% more duration on magic

 Lightning Laser:
loses 1 multicast overall
gains 40% aoe on rare
gains 2 multicasts on magic
gains 4 multicasts on legendary

 Erratic Bolt:
gains 1 multicast on rare
gains 100% more dmg on legendary
now has 10% chance for status (before 15%), which makes it much easier to deal more dmg with this skill
dmg efficiency increased by 25%

 Chain Shock:
now starts with 3 default targets
all rarity target increases now increased by 2

 Piercing Arrow:
now gains 4 multicast on rare
now gains 7 multicast on legendary
now gains 3 pierce on legendary



Small fixes and adjustments:

 updated most of the UI elements in the game, made borders cleaner, normalized dialog windows for stuff like prophecies or potential rifts. Also changed the default skill slot options to be in the top left, right under the healthbar in half size (Can be changed in the settings)
 added some small main menu animations for mythril drops
 implemented a "unlock countdown" for newer players
 in special circumstances its now possible to get the same relic twice
 nerfed flat damage mods of weapons to miniscule values (To make it very clear that those are the worst outcomes of item crafting)
 buffed weapon crafting by making flat damage mods not be able to appear as a legendary mod
 fixed a really sneaky and rare bug that caused the game to crash upon hovering over an "bug infected" item + implemented a fix for infected items to be made valid again
 added a scroll bar to the crafting menu, in case where the number of crafting options is so large that they got offscreen
 prepared the highscore reset, statistics relevant to the highscores are reset to 0 (all items, unlocks and upgrades will remain)
 added a page counter to the highscores page
 indirect damage now also counts towards the damage dealt statistic
 fixed the UI cooldown bug when Inability was active (Doubled cooldown was shown black)
 slightly improved the looks of the background map
 fixed a bug where the UI for gold drop was not disappearing if those spawned when the game was under 15 fps
 updated relic of handycap's text

notes.title: Elewar Steam-Release Patch! Achievements, Bosses and tons of QOL!
notes.content:
Gameplay Mechanics:


 The perks "% damage of element, + element damage and % penetration of element" are now limited to the selected elements in your run.
     Introducing a new periodic event on the map featuring two enigmatic squares, each marked with a unique symbol. Standing within these squares triggers a progress bar. Successfully filling this bar results in the appearance of a corresponding item on the map. Currently, there are five potential outcomes: Heart, Soul Magnetizer, Prophecy Whirl, Potential Rift, or +10 Gold. This empowers you to influence the type of random spawns you prefer, provided you can maintain the progress bar without leaving the squares.


Bosses:


     Added a new boss (physical).
     Added a new boss (lightning alternative).
     Added a new boss (cold alternative).
     Added a new boss (fire alternative).
     Added a new boss (physical alternative).
     Bosses now spawn every minute after 20 minutes, with 25 and 30 being double boss encounters.
     Prophecies and minute 20+ Boss encounters can now spawn all 8 bosses, while the 10-minute encounter randomly chooses from 4 bosses.


Realm and Trials:


     Reduced the number of trials per realm to 5 (making progress quicker but also harder on a per-trial basis), significantly increased gold bonus per trial. Hell now starts out with 150% extra gold without any trials active.


Upgrades and Crafting:


     Rebalanced the costs of upgrades.
     Enabled corrupted boots drops (These can have positive and negative modifiers, very limited crafting options).
     New special modifier for Hell: Bosses now have x% chance to drop corrupted boots.


Blessings:


     Implemented the blessings menu.
     Added 10 blessings to the game.


Achievements:


     Added 21 Steam achievements.


Localization:


     Added the German language to the game and Steam page.


Balance Adjustments:


     Slightly reduced the movementspeed penalty of frost.
     Base movementspeed +20, all classes should feel faster on a fresh save file (Base MS is now 160).
     Slightly reduced %MS on Helmets and Weapons to compensate.
     Reduced flat MS per upgrade point.
     Apprentice starts with less MS bonus.
     Lowered winters curve damage for enemies (Player version untouched), it was a tad too high.
     Reduced the extra % chance to get legendaries of Inferno prophecy to 100% (old 150%), increased its possible respawns to 3 (old 2).
     Minimap symbols, which appeared recently, blink repeatedly for a small duration.


Bug Fixes and Improvements:


     Added multithreaded loads for menus and the chosen map.
     Reduced the random spawn rate of magnets/hearts/potential rifts (Fixed spawns are the same) to compensate for the new event type.
     Made small improvements to the realm selection menu.
     Added a small animation to hearts.
     Slightly reduced elite enemy status ailment chance.
     Improved controller friendliness in some menus.
     Rebalanced the early game slightly, nerfed the machete guy's HP by about 20%.
     Fixed some line breaks in menus while using the German language.
     Removed Player Aliases from Relics for now.
     Fixed some relic typos in German.
     Added a 3rd map teaser 🙂
     Slightly improved highlighting to better show what spells can be chosen as a start spell.
     Added a page number to realm and class selection.
     Added a small visual indicator to the rarity mods of a spell (to grab attention).
     Added a teaser text to the apprentice.
     Added extra explanations in the inventory for the item slots.
     When not having any banishes and also having all spell slots full, you won't get any spells shown, and instead, only the consume button appears.
     Added a confirmation prompt to the action delete/sell item.
     Fixed translation errors for unlocked relics and several confusing translations for elemental penetration and pierce.
     Added minor visual differences to Procer and Duelist.
     Added a "selected" label for blessings.

notes.title: Elewar Prerelease Patch v0.0.9
notes.content:
Hey 
Its me Alex, bringing you a new prerelease update! After grinding my *** off in Path of Exile, im now at the step of finalizing the steam release!!

The release is really close, i would love to get some more feedback as the changes are HUGE! This version is playable on itch.io and will release in about 2-8 weeks on steam!

Game Mechanics and Balance Changes:

  
   New upgrade type: increased damage from spell level-ups.
     Legendary Lightning Laser now spawns an additional laser which extends to the sides of the target.
     Added an easier difficulty [more attack delays, warn timer increases, slower projectiles, less speed, lower damage for enemies].
     Reduced the difficulty curve in the early game, especially making enemies much less tanky in the first minutes of the run.
     Reworked some older stats like Rerolls/ Banishes etc. such that those can be made to appear on items or lvl-up perks (flexibility), introduced lots of new stat icons.
     Added tooltips to show the exact effects of your status ailments, based on your current status strength.
     Added a parry mechanic: the first hit taken during a parry will be ignored. 


New Content and Features:


     Added 2 blessings (Can't be chosen in this update).
     [BETA system] added the first challenge: survive 60 seconds in a small realm. When the progress bar of a world reaches 100% you may try yourself at its challenges [Challenge bar fills slowly with each minute survived in a normal run, once full you have endless attempts at the challenge realm]. One unlock's condition was redesigned to beat this challenge instead. We'll see in the future if more challenges should be added.
     Added 9 new songs.
     Implemented a pause menu.
     Added a character page for the pause menu where you can see the current selected class, equipped items, and the values of defensive + utility-oriented modifiers.
     Added a spell page for the pause menu. For every spell you own, you may check up on additional hidden values (Knockback distance, Penetration, Multicast delay, etc.) as well as the current run statistics like "Current DPS."
     You can now additionally look up all of the current stats for all your proc spells, as well as their basic statistics like DPS or damage dealt.
     Added a submenu to see all prophecies which were taken during a run.
     Added a prerun menu where you can select your starter spell. Additionally, you see the elements and spells chosen for this run in this menu (Will be able to reroll with some unlocks).
     Added 2 new prophecies: split the map by several lightning lasers.
     Added a new class: Duelist.
     Added a new utility spell: Parry.
     Split the Relic of Greed into 2 separate relics effects.
     Screen shockwaves are not paused when the game pauses.
     Added menu transition animations.
     Added notifications for a helmet drops. 


Bug Fixes and Optimization:

    
 Fixed a bug where hell scaling mod wasn't working properly.
     Fixed a lagspike introduced by triggering a prophecy with a laggy text.
     Fixed a bug where cast on cast could trigger itself.
     Fixed a bug where if you had a spell + had the same spell as a proc, the proc profited from level-ups despite having a fixed level.
     Small adjustments to the new tooltips, as well as new labels in the main menu which indicate the number of looted helmets and overall unlock percentage.
     Slightly reworked the after-run spell stats screen (icons, text size).

notes.title: Elewar Prerelease Patch v0.0.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
It's me Alex and I'm here to inform you of the new cool features in Elewar, which made it into the game even before it's officially released! Feel free to comment, suggest, share or request whatever you feel like :D

Game Mechanics Changes:

   
  Negative critical casts are able to cast spells by using cast-on-crit perks.
     All unlocks now cost 1 gold to activate the first time (removed costs).
     Monster now enrage after 30 seconds, gaining elite modifiers after 60 seconds (instead of 40/120).
     Added an experience bonus based on the number of unlocks bought.
     Slight enraging change for longer-living monsters: monsters slightly enrage every 20 seconds, making their attacks slightly more difficult (individual to the monster type). From 7 minutes into the run, they will get a random elite modifier spell whenever they lived longer than 120 seconds.


Upgrading and Unlock System Changes:

   
  Finished the new upgrading system.
     Reworked the unlock system internally (Can add new unlocks much faster and with multiple conditions).
     Nerved the starting stats of the player (significantly harder if playing without any upgrades).
     Added 4 new unlocks.
     Some relics have had their values reduced (mostly early game dmg relics).
     Added extra gold bonus based on how long you survived.
     Removed the forced lightning tag on the apprentice class (Instead starts with 1 extra lvl).


New Spelleffects and Status Ailments:

 
     Added a new special status ailment: freeze.
     In the process of making all spells unique and get something special on legendary rarity, the following additions were made:
         Sword Spin: Your swords spin an additional time.
         Chilling Trail: Freezes the first target. Freezing the same enemy repeatedly lowers the freeze duration.
         Chain Shock: Triggers a knockback shockwave (And keeps dmg per remaining target).
         Discharge: Magnetizes enemies to itself, scaling with knockback modifiers.
         Piercing Arrow: Your arrows return to you at the end of their lifetime. If they already return, then instead they gain +1 fork.
         Lightning Laser: Large laser range extension beyond the target (scales with AoE) (This one lost AoE below Legendary).
         Flaring Presence: A fireball orbits around your aura, damaging enemies it touches.
         Blazing Spot: Explodes at the end of the duration. Explosion deals 2 times the damage.
         Icicle Ruination: While having the maximum number of icicles spawn a damaging icy aura around you (No longer gets +1 pierce, maximum reduced by 5).
         Iceshot: Fork into 4 instead (Watching performance...).
         Flash Freeze: Added a new utility spell.


Map Changes:

 
     Increased the scaling difficulty of the second map: Hell (Starts out the same but gets harder faster). Should be comparable with Grassland middle trials. There is now a Rank system for maps: Hell has a scaling difficulty: C rank.
     Hell map starts out with a gold bonus and gets more gold per trial.
     Grassland lowered gold bonus per trial (Due to getting extra gold based on run duration, one progresses pretty fast).


New Content:

    
 Added a new monster
